chr_0002_endminm.name: Endministrator
chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: Endministrator's employment contract. You might be the Endministrator, but protocol and directive have necessitated these formalities...

chr_0003_endminf.name: Endministrator
chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: Endministrator's employment contract. You might be the Endministrator, but protocol and directive have necessitated these formalities...

chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica
chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: Perlica's employment contract. Our Supervisor might be very young, but she has conveyed the Endfield vision to everyone.

chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu
chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: Chen Qianyu's employment contract. Let me check how many times Operator Chen challenged other Endfielders to a spar... Uh... Oh dear... She probably figured out a new move and wanted to show everyone.

chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard
chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc: Wulfgard's employment contract. Trust this specialist from the Pack if you need to deal with nomads, frontiersmates, and Landbreakers.

chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight
chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: Arclight's employment contract. I really want to know how Operator Arclight understand this world as a scabhta of the Fiannæ Circuit... Talking with her feels quite ... exhausting.

chr_0009_azrila.name: Ember
chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Ember's employment contract. Her "Final Tribulation" has yet to end.

chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi
chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: Xaihi's employment contract. I have no choice but to endorse Xaihi's skills in living with various forms of machinery. However, I do not understand why she wants a copy of my voice generation suite.

chr_0012_avywen.name: Avywenna
chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: Avywenna's employment contract. She is incredibly motivated and passionate... Her communication skills are impeccable... Surprising enough, she also has the fighting abilities to match...

chr_0013_aglina.name: Gilberta
chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: Gilberta's employment contract. Complex hues of color, infinite possibilities, plus a dash of sweetness.

chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowshine
chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: Snowshine's employment contract. "Well, at least little miss reliable Snowshine is in the SAR team." Many operators will tell themselves this when receiving missions in extreme environments.

chr_0015_lifeng.name: Lifeng
chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: Lifeng's employment contract. Simple, sincere, understanding... And I believe that Lifeng may have completed a few more errands while I'm writing this down.

chr_0016_laevat.name: Laevatain
chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: Laevatain's employment contract. She spent years fighting demons and still her fire burns bright... if not brighter than before.

chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne
chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: Yvonne's employment contract. Her unique approach and modus operandi are proof of her ingenuity. She can always see things that no one else would notice, be it the strengths of her peers or the direction of someone's research project.

chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan
chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: Da Pan's employment contract. I believe that Operator Da Pan's friendly and easy-going nature is built upon his varied and extensive career that includes small business proprietor, electrician, carpenter, chauffeur...

common_2x3_l.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_add_endurance.name: Stamina Delimiter
item_add_endurance.decoDesc: The symbol of endurance. If necessary, this conceptual entity can become a brick. If things get even more desperate, life itself becomes a concept as well. The completion of our Tower is at hand.

item_adventureexp.name: Operational EXP
item_adventureexp.decoDesc: A form of experience you earn as you explore Talos-II. Like always, these lands await your discovery, Endministrator.

item_anglel_corp1_1.name: Savory Tangbao
item_anglel_corp1_1.decoDesc: A steaming hot tangbao (bun with soupy stuffing). Aggagrit seasoning gave it a savory and meaty aroma.

item_anglel_flower2_1.name: Citrome Pudding
item_anglel_flower2_1.decoDesc: They call this a pudding. Hey, where does the milky aroma come from?

item_anglem_corp1_1.name: Valley Graybread
item_anglem_corp1_1.decoDesc: At least it can fill an empty stomach.

item_anglem_flower2_1.name: Citrome Jelly
item_anglem_flower2_1.decoDesc: This jelly can still be easily made in the wildlands. It's made from citromes but you can't find any within it. Not one bit. Don't ask.

item_angles_corp1_1.name: Savory Tangmian
item_angles_corp1_1.decoDesc: A simple bowl of tangmian noodles in a clear soup. Prepared with a pinch of salt, a pinch of Aggagrit salt, a bowl of clear stock soup, and a spoonful of chopped scallions.

item_angles_flower2_1.name: Citrome Jam
item_angles_flower2_1.decoDesc: Sweet citrome jam with a perfect punch of sourness. Slivers of Aggagrit were added during the simmering process. The finished product gives off a cloyingly sweet aroma.

item_animal_angles_1.name: Savory Fillet
item_animal_angles_1.decoDesc: A meat fillet marinated with Aggagrit, salt, and spices. Aggagrit is a highly sought after condiment capable of granting food with unique flavors.

item_animal_insec2_angles_1.name: Fillet Confit
item_animal_insec2_angles_1.decoDesc: A meticulously prepared fillet. The many steps involved in its preparation give it a near-perfect taste.

item_ap_supply_nlt.name: Sanity Syrup
item_ap_supply_nlt.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you're seeing double when reading these instructions.

item_bottled_flower1spc_1.name: Buckpill [S]
item_bottled_flower1spc_1.decoDesc: A bottle of ingestible medicinal pills made with crafting.

item_bottled_flower1spc_2.name: Buckpill [L]
item_bottled_flower1spc_2.decoDesc: A bottle of medicinal pills made with crafting. This one offers a bigger content compared to its basic counterpart.

item_bottled_flower1spc_3.name: Buckpill [Rf.]
item_bottled_flower1spc_3.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical preparation made with simple processing. This one offers a larger dosage and better ingredients compared to its basic counterpart.

item_bottled_flower2spc_1.name: Citromix [S]
item_bottled_flower2spc_1.decoDesc: A blended mix made with simple filling. It has a very invigorating aroma of citromes.

item_bottled_flower2spc_2.name: Citromix [L]
item_bottled_flower2spc_2.decoDesc: A blended mix made with simple filling. This one offers a larger dosage compared to its basic counterpart.

item_bottled_flower2spc_3.name: Citromix [Rf.]
item_bottled_flower2spc_3.decoDesc: A blended mix made with simple filling. This one offers larger dosage and better ingredients compared to its basic counterpart.

item_bottled_food_1.name: Canned Citrome [C]
item_bottled_food_1.decoDesc: A cheap can of citromes. This serves as an accessible source of vitamins for settlers in the wildlands.

item_bottled_food_2.name: Canned Citrome [B]
item_bottled_food_2.decoDesc: Citrome now comes with revolutionary packaging. However, this was poorly received in the Civilization Band due to its excessive sugar content.

item_bottled_food_3.name: Canned Citrome [A]
item_bottled_food_3.decoDesc: A can of citromes made with fruits grown in natural and wholesome orchards. Fortified with small amounts of the essential vitamin suite. However, suggested retail price seems to be higher than its worth.

item_bottled_food_4.name: Jincao Drink
item_bottled_food_4.decoDesc: A carbonated beverage with a dash of jincao herbal extract. The refreshing aroma made this a popular drink.

item_bottled_food_5.name: Jincao Tea
item_bottled_food_5.decoDesc: A carbonated beverage made with jincao herbs. The process of preparation is based on time-tested herbal therapeutic traditions.

item_bottled_grass1spc_1.name: Jincao Tisane
item_bottled_grass1spc_1.decoDesc: A traditional tisane made by brewing a special blend of secret Jinlong herbs. The bitter taste will help you recall the saddest and most desperate times of your life.

item_bottled_grass1spc_2.name: Jincao Infusion
item_bottled_grass1spc_2.decoDesc: An herbal infusion made with simple filling. Anyone who could chug down a bottle in one go can be regarded as a true "hero".

item_bottled_grass2spc_1.name: Yazhen Spray [S]
item_bottled_grass2spc_1.decoDesc: A spray that can be made with crafting. Yazhen extracts make excellent insect repellents.

item_bottled_grass2spc_2.name: Yazhen Spray [L]
item_bottled_grass2spc_2.decoDesc: A simple spray made with a filling unit. Administer orally if necessary.

item_bottled_insec1_1.name: Arts Vial
item_bottled_insec1_1.decoDesc: A booster packaged in a vial imbued with Originium Arts. The contents activate the user's vitals, heighten the nervous system, and give an adrenaline boost.

item_bottled_insec1_2.name: Arts Tube
item_bottled_insec1_2.decoDesc: A booster packaged in a metallic tube imbued with Originium Arts. The contents activate the user's vitals, heighten the nervous system, and give a huge adrenaline boost.

item_bottled_insec2_1.name: Kunst Vial
item_bottled_insec2_1.decoDesc: A booster packaged in a vial imbued with special Originium Arts. It contains sharp micro-clusters that can activate the user's vitals, excite the nervous system, and accelerate adrenaline secretion.

item_bottled_insec2_2.name: Kunst Tube
item_bottled_insec2_2.decoDesc: A booster packaged in a metal canister imbued with special Originium Arts. It contains sharp micro-clusters that can activate the user's vitals, excite the nervous system, and greatly accelerate adrenaline secretion.

item_bottled_moss_1_2_1.name: Perplexing Medication
item_bottled_moss_1_2_1.decoDesc: A medicine prepared by Linnaeus. It is infused with his personal emotions and has a perplexing yet rich blend of flavors.

item_bottled_moss_2_animal_1.name: Bizarro Chili
item_bottled_moss_2_animal_1.decoDesc: A uniquely flavored meat stew made using Anthony's family recipe. A wildland wanderer like Anthony often carried this chili along with him. It reminds him of home and gives him the calories he needs.

item_bottled_moss_spc_1_2_1.name: Citrobucky Mix
item_bottled_moss_spc_1_2_1.decoDesc: A medical salve made with crafting. The formula is quite a mess. The same can be said of its taste.

item_bottled_rec_hp_1.name: Buck Capsule [C]
item_bottled_rec_hp_1.decoDesc: A simple capsule made with crafting. It is quite leaky, and shaking it around might reduce its potency.

item_bottled_rec_hp_2.name: Buck Capsule [B]
item_bottled_rec_hp_2.decoDesc: A capsule prepared using the processes of standard pharmaceutical packaging. Endfield Industries once tried to market this but the amount sold barely came to a fraction of the competing Rhodes Island product.

item_bottled_rec_hp_3.name: Buck Capsule [A]
item_bottled_rec_hp_3.decoDesc: A capsule prepared using optimized packaging techniques. This Endfield product was designed for ease-of-use in combat scenarios.

item_bottled_rec_hp_4.name: Yazhen Syringe [C]
item_bottled_rec_hp_4.decoDesc: Can only be administered via subcutaneous injection.

item_bottled_rec_hp_5.name: Yazhen Syringe [A]
item_bottled_rec_hp_5.decoDesc: Endfield Industries once attempted to develop a Protocol-Injection technology but the project was eventually canned. They ultimately lacked the courage to unleash something that would revolutionize the entire industry.

item_bp_miner_3.name: Electric Mining Rig Mk II Template

item_carbon_enr.name: Stabilized Carbon
item_carbon_enr.decoDesc: Multiple processing steps have achieved a delicate balance for this brick of elemental carbon.

item_carbon_enr_powder.name: Dense Carbon Powder
item_carbon_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to create this uniquely fine powdered preparation of Carbon.

item_carbon_mtl.name: Carbon
item_carbon_mtl.decoDesc: During the war, Endfield Industries managed to optimize their waste emission carbon capture technology.

item_carbon_powder.name: Carbon Powder
item_carbon_powder.decoDesc: Carbon can be shredded to yield a powdered product.

item_case_example1.name: Special Supply EX
item_case_example1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of useful materials gathered from various regions. Use the contents to improve an operator in every aspect.

item_case_example2.name: Essence Supply EX
item_case_example2.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of useful essences gathered from various regions. Your weapon can be the latest experimental prototype, but this crate will have a fitting essence for it.

item_case_example3.name: Token Supply EX
item_case_example3.decoDesc: Endfielders have to do plenty of traveling to prepare this crate of operator tokens. Every token was carefully placed, but the crate always ends up messy.

item_case_example4.name: Weapon Supply EX
item_case_example4.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of weapons gathered from various regions. Certain prankers have a habit of placing excessively dangerous weapons in this crate to give their friends a "surprise".

item_case_example5.name: Gear Supply EX
item_case_example5.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of gear and PPE gathered from various regions. Although many suppliers have shared gear blueprints and production permits with Endfield, they will stop at nothing to promote their products.

item_case_gem_random_1.name: Essence Supply EX
item_case_gem_random_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of useful essences gathered from various regions. Your weapon can be the latest experimental prototype, but this crate will have a fitting essence for it.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.name: Targeted Weapon Supply
item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of weapons gathered from various regions. Certain prankers have a habit of placing excessively dangerous weapons in this crate to give their friends a "surprise".

item_char_break_stage_1_2.name: Protodisk
item_char_break_stage_1_2.decoDesc: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard data etching processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_break_stage_3_4.name: Protoset
item_char_break_stage_3_4.decoDesc: A special disk set manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced data etching processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_10_12.name: Proto-Extract
item_char_skill_level_10_12.decoDesc: A stable material extracted from Blighted environments using specialized Techno-Protocol. It can improve bodily tolerance for more powerful enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_1_6.name: Protoprism
item_char_skill_level_1_6.decoDesc: A special crystal prism manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_7_12.name: Protohedron
item_char_skill_level_7_12.decoDesc: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: Disappoint not, despair not, forget not.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: Disappoint not, despair not, forget not.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: Perlica's little workshop is filled with all sorts of experimental industrial products that may also be treated as creative kitbashes. "What is this?" Good question. Maybe you should ask her in person.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: Operator Chen has exceptional weapon maintenance skills. In any case, she can hone any edge perfectly without much thought. Chen may have acquired this ability through a lot of practice, especially given her equally exceptional weapon failure rates.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc: "A handcannon, even the simpler sort, has more than a hundred parts, yes? If things get desperate, I can use any one of those parts as a weapon." Wulfgard told me this in a half-joking tone. I think he was making things up.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: Most people might find the songs of the Fiannæ Circuit difficult to understand, but every word was written with the blood of those who walked before us. Every line carried a lesson to guide us forward. When we heard Operator Arclight's explanations, we were suddenly able to visualize what the songs actually meant.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.name: Ember's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Her witnesses are the tainted snow, the dormant peaks, and the burning pyre. Ignatia's Crusade is far from over.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: Another side of Talos-II lurks within datastreams that still flow amongst ancient ruins. I pray you can lift its veil and dispel its disguise, and let the revelation of Unseen Veritas descend upon this world.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0012_avywen.name: Avywenna's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: A handful of dirt, a note, and a bottle of perfume... Messengers often acquire a stash of souvenirs throughout their career. The stash represents the "strings" they had woven to mend the broken land.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.name: Gilberta's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: Children are always looking forward to Miss Gilberta's presents. A piece of sweet would often do the trick. Miss Gilberta knows all sorts of presents to make them smile.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowshine's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: Snowshine's runes read: "May you be forever one step ahead of the storm." Deep down, she wishes that anyone trapped in the snow can outpace the storm. Every step taken will get them away from the howling disaster and closer to their homes.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Lifeng's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: The chrome needs lubricants. The mind needs enlightenment.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.name: Laevatain's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: Every crossed out location and every page ripped out from Laevatain's logs symbolized the scars of brutal battles and a smoking trail of towns razed to the ground.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: "Quick! After her! She just left a note and ran off to another Blight event site!"

item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc:
"Master Pan, why don't you tell us more?" 
  "Tell you more of what?" 
  "You followed these blueprints and built an industrial gigaplex years ago. Perhaps there were some experiences you'd like to share." 
  "Experiences I'd like to share? Ohoho. You're in for a long story."

item_collection_ether.name: Ætherium
item_collection_ether.decoDesc: A point of weakness linking the Ætherside to realspace.

item_collection_frag.name: Æther Manifest Shard
item_collection_frag.decoDesc: A fragment of an object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.

item_collection_instance.name: Æther Manifest
item_collection_instance.decoDesc: An object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.

item_copper_cmpt.name: Cuprium Part
item_copper_cmpt.decoDesc: A Cuprium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_jar.name: Cuprium Jar
item_copper_jar.decoDesc: Cuprium jars are pretty rare in the market because cuprium is a more expensive metal than ferrium.

item_copper_nugget.name: Cuprium
item_copper_nugget.decoDesc: Smelted Cuprium becomes harder and less likely to oxidize.

item_copper_ore.name: Cuprium Ore
item_copper_ore.decoDesc: A natural mineral complex unique to the Jinlong region. Metals acquired by refining this ore form the basis for local industry and production.

item_copper_powder.name: Cuprium Powder
item_copper_powder.decoDesc: Cuprium can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_corp1_animal_1.name: Mossfield Pie
item_corp1_animal_1.decoDesc: A meat pie. Every Mossfield resident grew up eating the famous Mossfield pie. Steaming pies, the stove, and a loving family always bring people hope.

item_corp1_flower1_1.name: Coarse Flatbread
item_corp1_flower1_1.decoDesc: A simple flatbread. Usually served with a soup or stew. The flatbread is the staple of most people forced to make a living in the wildlands.

item_corp2_animal_1.name: Meat Stir-Fry
item_corp2_animal_1.decoDesc: Cubes of meat stir-fried over hot fire. A hungry diner can easily go through three bowls of rice with a serving of meat stir-fry. There's a good reason why this is the *most* popular dish in the frontier.

item_corp2_flower2_1.name: Tartpepper Salad
item_corp2_flower2_1.decoDesc: A salad toss of tartpepper leaves. People in the frontier regard the leaves of the tartpepper as the "most bitter thing in the frontier". However, there are some who still enjoy its crunchy texture and refreshing aroma.

item_corp3_animal_1.name: Ginseng Meat Stew
item_corp3_animal_1.decoDesc: A herbal meal prepared by stewing redjade ginseng roots, meat fillet, and other ingredients. A common winter dish of the Jinlong region. When the snow starts falling, a bowl of this hearty stew would offer the warmth you need.

item_corp3_grass1_1.name: Fortifying Infusion
item_corp3_grass1_1.decoDesc: A herbal infusion prepared by decocting redjade ginseng and jincao herbs. Typically consumed to revitalize the body. Many grievously wounded warriors used this decoction to treat various chronic conditions.

item_corp4_animal_1.name: Wuling Fried Rice
item_corp4_animal_1.decoDesc: A mysterious Ursine chef came up with this recipe as he traveled across the lands. It became famous throughout the frontier for its delicious blend of sweetness and heat.

item_corp4_grass2_1.name: Garden Fried Rice
item_corp4_grass2_1.decoDesc: Fried rice made with less oil and salt to bring out the wholesome flavors of garden greens and vegetables.

item_crystal_enr.name: Packed Origocrust
item_crystal_enr.decoDesc: The Packed Origocrust is a result of multiple processing steps and looks just like a piece of precious "gemstone".

item_crystal_enr_powder.name: Dense Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to prepare this dense powdered form of Origocrust with particles almost invisible to the unaided eye.

item_crystal_powder.name: Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_powder.decoDesc: Origocrust can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_crystal_shell.name: Origocrust
item_crystal_shell.decoDesc: The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.

item_diamond.name: Oroberyl
item_diamond.decoDesc: A special product of cut Origeometry. These stones are extremely popular due to their beauty and wide range of uses.

item_drop_angle_l_1.name: Aggagrit Cluster
item_drop_angle_l_1.decoDesc: A large stony cluster with a strange, aromatic scent. Use this to marinate food to grant them a special flavor.

item_drop_angle_m_1.name: Aggagrit Block
item_drop_angle_m_1.decoDesc: A large piece of rock with a strange, aromatic scent. Use this to marinate food to grant them a special flavor.

item_drop_angle_s_1.name: Aggagrit
item_drop_angle_s_1.decoDesc: A piece of stone with a strange, aromatic scent. Use this to marinate food to grant them a special flavor.

item_drop_animal_1.name: Fillet
item_drop_animal_1.decoDesc: A piece of fillet. It seems pretty fresh.

item_drop_eb_jl_m_1.name: Soaked Wood
item_drop_eb_jl_m_1.decoDesc: A piece of wood soaked in a special mountain spring and is way bigger and heavier than an ordinary woodchip. Can either be used as fuel or for smoking food to grant them a unique flavor.

item_drop_eb_jl_s_1.name: Soaked Woodchip
item_drop_eb_jl_s_1.decoDesc: A piece of woodchip soaked in a special mountain spring. Can either be used as fuel or for smoking food to grant them a unique flavor.

item_drop_eb_l_1.name: Cartilage Bit
item_drop_eb_l_1.decoDesc: Pieces of firm and flexible cartilaginous material. Maybe you can add this to a soup to enrich its flavors.

item_drop_eb_m_1.name: Chitin Bit
item_drop_eb_m_1.decoDesc: Pieces from the chitinous exoskeleton of an unknown critter. The brilliant colors suggest that this material may be toxic.

item_drop_eb_s_1.name: Grass Chaff
item_drop_eb_s_1.decoDesc: Dried, withered bits of grass seeds and chaff. Nobody knows why Landbreakers would gather these things.

item_drop_enemycommon_1.name: Decryption Crystal
item_drop_enemycommon_1.decoDesc: The HQ provides gear design drawings while decryption crystals offer the necessary environmental readings. Combine these 2 to properly assemble a proper piece of Endfield gear.

item_drop_erosion_m_1.name: Hollow Bone
item_drop_erosion_m_1.decoDesc: Blight-tainted bone that is unusually hollow. Despite being far bigger than ordinary bones, it feels as light as a feather.

item_drop_erosion_s_1.name: Hollow Bonechip
item_drop_erosion_s_1.decoDesc: An unusually hollow bone created by the Blight. This ordinary-looking piece of bone is surprisingly heavy.

item_e1m1_treasure.name: TEMP: Super Valuable Cargo
item_e1m1_treasure.decoDesc: TEMP: Super valuable cargo. Seems to contain some unknown medication emitting a green glow.

item_e2m2_ID.name: Park Access Card
item_e2m2_ID.decoDesc: An access card from Aleeza Collins. It might be useful in the Originium Science Park.

item_ebl_corp2_1.name: Hot Crunchy Ribs
item_ebl_corp2_1.decoDesc: A kebab of heavily seasoned crunchy rib. Avoid eating too much of this because clean water is actually pretty hard to find in the wildlands.

item_ebl_flower1_1.name: Cartilage Tack
item_ebl_flower1_1.decoDesc: Salty cookies with bits of cartilaginous material. This recipe was rumored to be created by the Landbreakers. It would seem that these pipefaces actually appreciate a nice meal.

item_ebm_corp2_1.name: Firetack
item_ebm_corp2_1.decoDesc: A protein-rich mass of grubbiness seasoned with ample heat and spice. Though bug-related, the crunch, juiciness, and flavors will get you rumbling for more.

item_ebm_flower1_1.name: Bugtack
item_ebm_flower1_1.decoDesc: A protein-rich hardtack. Ignore the ingredients and just bite really hard into it.

item_ebs_corp2_1.name: Tartpepper Pickle
item_ebs_corp2_1.decoDesc: This should be pickled for at least a month, but waiting is a luxury for wildlanders like you. Keep it simple and bitter.

item_ebs_flower1_1.name: Bizarrotack
item_ebs_flower1_1.decoDesc: Salty, sweet, with a hint of heat. Despite being called a tack, it tastes more like a piece of freeze-dried vegetable.

item_equip_script_1.name: Amethyst Component
item_equip_script_1.decoDesc: The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol mould (BASUP-mould). Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.

item_equip_script_2.name: Ferrium Component

item_gift_fashion_3.decoDesc: Woven using lava rock fibers of the Tvashtar Volcano. Printed with patterns that exude extreme power.

item_gift_food_1.decoDesc: From the ovens of Madeleine Patisserie comes this soft, spongy, and sweet work of love. A work of art decorated by the finest fondant icing.

item_gift_knowledge_1.decoDesc: An internal periodical of Endfield Industries. The magazine shares various news of the frontier (and information about their Endministrator).

item_log_belt_01.name: Transport Belt
item_log_belt_01.decoDesc: A basic conveyor belt for transporting things. Belts are the blood vessels of the AIC Factory.

item_log_connector.name: Belt Bridge
item_log_connector.decoDesc: A logistics unit that AIC managers can use to create an organized transport system and avoid the "spaghetti".

item_log_converger.name: Converger
item_log_converger.decoDesc: A transport system adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.

item_log_pipe_01.name: Pipe
item_log_pipe_01.decoDesc: A survey revealed that nearly 30% of residents in the Civilization Band believe that a dark and massive underground kingdom exists within the sprawling urban sewers.

item_log_pipe_connector.name: Pipe Bridge
item_log_pipe_connector.decoDesc: This logistics unit is furnished with special fluid control valves developed by Endfield Industries. However, its unique industrial designs have greatly limited its success in the market.

item_log_pipe_converger.name: Pipe Converger
item_log_pipe_converger.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.

item_log_pipe_repeater.name: Pipe Support
item_log_pipe_repeater.decoDesc: An elevated support made using special steel. It is capable of bearing great loads.

item_log_pipe_splitter.name: Pipe Splitter
item_log_pipe_splitter.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.

item_log_splitter.name: Splitter
item_log_splitter.decoDesc: A transport belt adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.

item_m1m8_grassSample_1.name: Fluffed Jincao Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_1.decoDesc: A thriving Fluffed Jincao plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_m1m8_grassSample_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Sample

item_mission_c1m1_wolftracker.name: Special Tracker
item_mission_c1m1_wolftracker.decoDesc: A special tracker that Wulfgard left behind, just in case.

item_mission_e2m3_key.name: Backup ID Pass
item_mission_e2m3_key.decoDesc: A backup ID pass. Use it to activate the control panel and open the gate of the Originium Science Park.

item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.name: Tata's Log I
item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.decoDesc: An image record of the Blight Core taken by Tata at the entrance of the Research Center building.

item_mission_e4m1_tatapicb.name: Tata's Log II
item_mission_e4m1_tatapicb.decoDesc: An image record taken with Tata's perspective. CONTENT: Endfield Crisis Team resting next to the signal tower at the Origin Lodespring.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.name: Distorted Key
item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.decoDesc: A common key picked up in a mining tunnel, but it has been so malformed that it can no longer be used.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.name: Metal Component
item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.decoDesc: Old metal components found in the mines.

item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.name: Steel Oath Medical Crate
item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.decoDesc: A medical supplies crate with the designs and markings of the Order of Steel Oath. The Order uses this to store commonly used medical supplies.

item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.name: Quarry Elevator Keycard
item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.decoDesc: A keycard received from a UWST SAR Crew Mate. It is used to activate the elevators in certain areas.

item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.name: Worn Key Card
item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.decoDesc: A worn key card. It looks really old.

item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.name: Damaged Meds Box
item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.decoDesc: A box dented by heavy blows. There are some medicines left inside.

item_mission_tianshi_talisman.name: Jade Key
item_mission_tianshi_talisman.decoDesc: A part acquired by repairing the Tianshi Pylon. Collect 5 to activate the large Tianshi Shrine.

item_originium_enr_powder.name: Dense Originium Powder
item_originium_enr_powder.decoDesc: The UWST Originium cultivation project initially attempted "powder seeding" but the resulting crystal clusters would often lose their activity quickly.

item_originium_ore.name: Originium Ore
item_originium_ore.decoDesc: A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.

item_originium_powder.name: Originium Powder
item_originium_powder.decoDesc: Endfield made use of Techno-Protocol to create a stable form of Originium Powder.

item_originium_recharge.name: Origeometry
item_originium_recharge.decoDesc: A derivative of Protocol Originium that can only be made with the most extreme processing environments. Some Endfielders call this the Tear of the Protocol. They believe that Dijiang felt sorrow and shed these Tears when she silently gazed upon the suffering of the Talosians.

item_plant_bbflower_1.name: Aketine
item_plant_bbflower_1.decoDesc: Aketine is a species of flora native to Talos-II. It usually grows at places with unique soil composition.

item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.name: Aketine Powder
item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.decoDesc: It is easier to extract target materials and substances from shredded Aketine.

item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.name: Aketine Seed
item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.decoDesc: Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. Scientists believe this is caused by the absorption of rainwater with excessively high levels of Blighted materials.

item_plant_crylplant_1_1.name: Kalkodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_1.decoDesc: Dendra extracts were once used as emergency medication.

item_plant_crylplant_1_2.name: Chrysodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_2.decoDesc: Dendras are plants native to Talos-II. Cultivating dendras can be quite a challenge.

item_plant_crylplant_1_3.name: Vitrodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_3.decoDesc: Accidental consumption of dendras may lead to high blood pressure, faster heart rates, nauseousness, and vomiting.

item_plant_crylplant_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf
item_plant_crylplant_2_1.decoDesc: Some scientists believe that certain Blight conditions can transform any bush or shrubs into the Blighted Jadeleaves.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.name: Kalkodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.name: Chrysodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Chrysodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.name: Vitrodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Vitrodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Blighted Jadeleaf tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_grass_1.name: Jincao
item_plant_grass_1.decoDesc: The jincao plant is commonly known as the "silkstar grass", named after the star-like flowers of the plant. The plant usually grows on shaded hillslopes.

item_plant_grass_2.name: Yazhen
item_plant_grass_2.decoDesc: The yazhen plant is an extremely hardy grass native to the Jinlong region. The plant produces a rather beautiful bloom during summer.

item_plant_grass_powder_1.name: Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_1.decoDesc: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_powder_2.name: Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_2.decoDesc: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_seed_1.name: Jincao Seed
item_plant_grass_seed_1.decoDesc: Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.

item_plant_grass_seed_2.name: Yazhen Seed
item_plant_grass_seed_2.decoDesc: Yazhen seeds have tiny hooks that aid in their attachment to animal fur for dispersion.

item_plant_grass_spc_1.name: Fluffed Jincao
item_plant_grass_spc_1.decoDesc: Some people in Jinlong believe that the jincao plant symbolizes hardiness. Many pieces of local literature use the plant as a metaphor for toughness and survival.
obtainWays: Gather Jincao for a chance to get this

item_plant_grass_spc_2.name: Thorny Yazhen
item_plant_grass_spc_2.decoDesc: The thorny leaves of the yazhen plant can be used for angling. A few simple steps and bending would create a very effective angling hook.
obtainWays: Gather Yazhen for a chance to get this

item_plant_grass_spc_powder_1.name: Fluffed Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_1.decoDesc: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_moss_1.name: Buckflower
item_plant_moss_1.decoDesc: When the War just began, a Hongshan recon team discovered a plant with brightly colored flowers. Extracts of this plant can be used as an anti-hemorrhagic agent.

item_plant_moss_2.name: Citrome
item_plant_moss_2.decoDesc: Citromes are part of the botanical genus of Zitro that usually grows in the central continental region of Talos-II. The species and cultivars grown in the Civilization Band tend to yield large fruits with tough, fibrous flesh.

item_plant_moss_3.name: Sandleaf
item_plant_moss_3.decoDesc: The Fiannæ Circuit proved themselves as the true masters of wilderness crafting and would use all sorts of natural materials to aid in their crafting.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.name: Ground Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this buckflower preparation with "strangely" improved pharmaceutical activity.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.name: Ground Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Citrome preparation with an extremely bitter taste.

item_plant_moss_powder_1.name: Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_1.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the pharmaceutical effectiveness of Buckflower.

item_plant_moss_powder_2.name: Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_2.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the flavors of Citrome.

item_plant_moss_powder_3.name: Sandleaf Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_3.decoDesc: Shredding releases the abrasive grit from sandleaf tissues for industrial use.

item_plant_moss_seed_1.name: Buckflower Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_1.decoDesc: The Buckflower earned its name as it was first found under a natural arch that resembled a bucking, jumping beast.

item_plant_moss_seed_2.name: Citrome Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_2.decoDesc: Hobby botanists and gardeners of the Civilization Band once voted for the Most Common Plants in the Wildlands. Buckflower and Citromes both made it to the top 10 of the list.

item_plant_moss_seed_3.name: Sandleaf Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_3.decoDesc: The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. People forced to live in the wildlands had to do everything they could to survive.

item_plant_moss_spc_1.name: Firebuckle
item_plant_moss_spc_1.decoDesc: Buckflowers bloom in mid-April. Plants with the most fiery-red flowers would be called Firebuckles.
obtainWays: Gather Buckflowers for a chance to get this

item_plant_moss_spc_2.name: Umbraline
item_plant_moss_spc_2.decoDesc: Around 12 major Citrome cultivars are currently sold in the markets of the Civilization Band. They come in all sorts of names and offer different juiciness and sugar content. However, they are all Citromes.
obtainWays: Gather Citromes for a chance to get this

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.name: Firebuckle Powder
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.decoDesc: A simple powdered preparation of Firebuckle. You can use it to treat wounds, but its pharmaceutical potential goes way beyond that.

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.name: Citromix
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: A simple blended preparation that can be consumed by mixing with some water. If you're unlucky, you might get some bitter bits of rind in your pack.

item_plant_mushroom_1_1.name: Pink Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_1.decoDesc: Toxicity of the ruby bolete (Boleta rubra) would already be extremely high when the sporocarp reaches a certain size and starts acquiring a reddish hue. This is the pink stage.

item_plant_mushroom_1_2.name: Red Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_2.decoDesc: Ruby boletes with darker hues provide extracts with greater pharmaceutical values. This is the red stage.

item_plant_mushroom_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_3.decoDesc: Every year, many frontier settlers would suffer multiple organ failure caused by ruby bolete poisoning. This often results from misjudging the edible stage of the fungus. Eating the fungus in ruby stage is extremely dangerous.

item_plant_mushroom_2_1.name: Bloodcap
item_plant_mushroom_2_1.decoDesc: Bloodcap is likely to be a variant of a carnivorous fungus mutated by ambient Blight. Nutrients consumed by the fungus would course through its mycelia.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.name: Pink Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Pink Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.name: Red Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Redbolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Ruby Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.name: Bloodcap Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Bloodcap mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.name: Rare Fungus
item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.decoDesc: A rare fungus that grows in Valley IV. It can be used as a catalyst when making medication. UWST scientist Linnaeus was the first to discover this property.

item_plant_sp_1.name: Reed Rye
item_plant_sp_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye is a hardy cereal with an impressive yield. It is the staple food of most settlers in the frontier.

item_plant_sp_2.name: Tartpepper
item_plant_sp_2.decoDesc: The leaves of this plant are considered the "most bitter herbs of the frontier".

item_plant_sp_3.name: Redjade Ginseng
item_plant_sp_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng is a mild herb often consumed by people in Hongshan as a fortifying supplement.

item_plant_sp_4.name: Amber Rice
item_plant_sp_4.decoDesc: The rounded, jade-like endosperm of the Amber Rice is also regarded as "amber pearls".

item_plant_sp_seed_1.name: Reed Rye Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_2.name: Tartpepper Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_2.decoDesc: Tartpepper seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_3.name: Redjade Ginseng Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_4.name: Amber Rice Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_4.decoDesc: Amber Rice seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_spc_2.name: Variant Tartpepper
item_plant_sp_spc_2.decoDesc: A mutant variant of Tartpepper. It bears a yellow-colored fruit with an extremely spicy taste.

item_plant_spcstone_1_1.name: Kalkonyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_1.decoDesc: Nyxites are also known as the "ancient mineral" and symbolize an age of destruction of such a scale never witnessed by humanity. They come in various hues.

item_plant_spcstone_1_2.name: Auronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_2.decoDesc: Humans have yet to figure out how nyxites form. This secret of Talos-II has yet to unveil itself.
obtainWays: Originium Science Park: Outside the Research Center

item_plant_spcstone_1_3.name: Umbronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_3.decoDesc: People usually name nyxite crystals based on their color (Kalkonyx, Auronyx, and Umbronyx) but these differences are just caused by the extent of oxidation.

item_plant_spcstone_2_1.name: Igneosite
item_plant_spcstone_2_1.decoDesc: Scientists postulate that Igneosites are metamorphic forms of nyxite subject to volcanic eruptions followed by Blight exposure.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.name: Kalkonyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkonyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.name: Auronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.decoDesc: An Auronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.name: Umbronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.decoDesc: An Umbronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_1.name: Igneosite Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_1.decoDesc: An Igneosite seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_tundra_insect_1.name: Glowbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_1.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can give off a gentle glow.

item_plant_tundra_insect_2.name: Scorchbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_2.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can glow and give off a bit of heat.

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.name: Glowbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Glowbugs can still give off a gentle glow.

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.name: Scorchbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Scorchbugs can still give off a gentle glow. NOTE: Monitor facility temperature during processing.

item_plant_tundra_wood.name: Wood
item_plant_tundra_wood.decoDesc: Let's chop down some trees first.

item_port_battle_cannon_1.name: Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_1.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed Originium grenades. Designs are based on small field guns used during the Aggeloi War.

item_port_battle_cannon_2.name: HE Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_2.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed high explosive (HE) Originium grenades. This facility deals more devastating area damage compared to its standard counterpart.

item_port_battle_frost_1.name: LN Tower
item_port_battle_frost_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon with ammo of special crystal rounds filled with liquid nitrogen (LN). The ammo would shatter upon impact, spilling its freezing contents onto the enemy to inflict frostbite that impedes their movements.

item_port_battle_laser_1.name: Beam Tower
item_port_battle_laser_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon armed with an energy converter. Treat this as a miniaturized version of a city-defense giga-cannon. The system is unpopular in the arms market due to its steep energy demands and the fact that it is an unstable and risky weapon platform.

item_port_battle_laser_2.name: HF Beam Tower
item_port_battle_laser_2.decoDesc: An upgraded version of the Beam Tower. Endfield Industries improved the stability of this weapon platform with its Protocol Originium. Unfortunately, no one managed to reduce its massive energy consumption.

item_port_battle_lightning_1.name: Surge Tower
item_port_battle_lightning_1.decoDesc: Years of research on electricity-related Originium Arts gave rise to the Surge Tower. Power output has been greatly increased while minimizing the risk of friendly fire.

item_port_battle_medic_1.name: Medical Tower
item_port_battle_medic_1.decoDesc: A healing facility furnished with medical Arts casting units. The designers made the tower spherical because gentle curves are visually more comforting to the injured.

item_port_battle_shockwave_1.name: Sonic Tower
item_port_battle_shockwave_1.decoDesc:
A crowd control facility furnished with a specialized Arts unit. It can emit targeted sonic waves that overwhelm an entity's nervous systems to stun them. 
Given the amount of power available, these sonic waves can even disrupt Aggeloid movements.

item_port_battle_sniper_1.name: Sentry Tower
item_port_battle_sniper_1.decoDesc: This weapon is inspired by the ranged weaponry of the Aggeloi. The designer has furnished it with high-precision optical recognition modules to accurately target high-threat targets and deal effective damage.

item_port_battle_turret_1.name: Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_1.decoDesc: Once the complex Artslock mechanism was simplified, it was combined with the logic of automation designs to create this integrated weapon platform. Many frontier outposts and villages used prototypes of this system to defend themselves against dangerous wildlife.

item_port_battle_turret_2.name: Heavy Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_2.decoDesc: An upgraded version of the Gun Tower. People call this the Tomb Digger due to its merciless killing power.

item_port_cmpt_mc_1.name: Fitting Unit
item_port_cmpt_mc_1.decoDesc: Comes with grinding wheels, planing wheels, polishing bits, and milling cutters.

item_port_dumper_1.name: Fluid Supply Unit
item_port_dumper_1.decoDesc: "Give me an alternative function. I need sales!"

item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_heal.decoDesc: The injector delivers sealants into cracks to help repair broken shields. People also used this in emergencies for sealing wounds.

item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_phy.name: Swordmancer Flint
item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_phy.decoDesc: The flint essentially overclocks and depletes the energy reserves of the Swordmancer armor system. It only lights when the wearer brushes against death itself.

item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_poise.name: Æthertech Watch
item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_poise.decoDesc: "Some so-called users claim that our products exerted hemo-mutagenic influences on them. They're nothing but baseless accusations."

item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_pulse_cryst.name: Pulser Labs Invasion Core
item_unit_t5_edc_03_suit_pulse_cryst.decoDesc: Assistance from the Cabal of Tranquility created an infiltration core capable of breaching most terminal firewalls.

item_unit_t5_edc_04_suit_criti.name: MI Security Push Knife MOD
item_unit_t5_edc_04_suit_criti.decoDesc: The hilt is filled with an Originium propellant. Plunge this at the enemy and squeeze the trigger to fire the blade. It will instantly tear apart the enemy's armor and flesh like a knife through sponge cake.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_parts_atk.name: Redeemer Gloves FORCE
item_unit_t5_hand_01_parts_atk.decoDesc: The quest is not yet finished, and so the journey is not yet complete.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_atb.name: Frontiers Blight RES Gloves MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_atb.decoDesc: The goal of the Frontiersmate PPE is to give a squad of 3 to 5 combatants the ability to directly engage and terminate clutches of Aggeloi.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_attri.name: Bonekrusha Wristband MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_attri.decoDesc: Not every wildlander becomes a Landbreaker, but no one could ever escape the bindings of the wild.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_criti.name: MI Security Gloves MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_criti.decoDesc: These gloves can also be used as a weapon. The V&V process probably includes a step to measure its capability of smashing an Aggeloid appendage.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_fire_natr.name: Hot Work Gloves
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_fire_natr.decoDesc: UWST and Endfield Industries jointly developed the Hot Work series PPE to explore high-heat environments.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_heal.name: LYNX Gloves MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_heal.decoDesc: Rhodes Island still has a tradition of furnishing their PPE with Oripathy monitoring modules.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_phy.name: Swordmancer TAC Gauntlets
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_phy.decoDesc: Year's end. Brought my blade south. The mountain grew nine heads and roared incessantly. It was a day of auspice.

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_poise.name: Æthertech Gloves
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_poise.decoDesc: "Always wear extra padding when using our products. If you experience any auditory or visual hallucinations, please TAKE OFF our products IMMEDIATELY and consume some food."

item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_pulse_cryst.name: Pulser Labs Gloves
item_unit_t5_hand_01_suit_pulse_cryst.decoDesc: Most could not understand why Endfield Industries added better thermal insulation for their Pulser Labs series PPE.

item_unit_t5_hand_02_parts_atk.name: Redeemer Gloves DEX
item_unit_t5_hand_02_parts_atk.decoDesc: The quest is not yet finished, and so the journey is not yet complete.

item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_atb.name: Frontiers Fiber Gloves MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_atb.decoDesc: An underwater combat armor from the Frontiersmate series. Special fiber weaving technology gave these gloves oxygen cycling functions.

item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_criti.name: MI Security Hands PPE MOD
item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_criti.decoDesc: Armbands with miniaturized Arts units for riot control. Features excellent energy conductance.

item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_fire_natr.name: Hot Work Gauntlets
item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_fire_natr.decoDesc: "Shh, quiet. You might wake it up."

item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_phy.name: Swordmancer TAC Fists
item_unit_t5_hand_02_suit_phy.decoDesc: V&V process for the tactical gauntlets include this particular test: Make a 24-fold flower with Xuan paper.

item_weapon_break_high.name: Heavy Cast Die
item_weapon_break_high.decoDesc: A heavy casting die made using rare materials. Techno-Protocol activation lets this die enhance general material strengths in weapons.

item_weapon_break_low.name: Cast Die
item_weapon_break_low.decoDesc: A casting die made using rare materials. Techno-Protocol activation lets this die enhance general material strengths in weapons.

item_weapon_expcard_high.name: Arms INSP Set
item_weapon_expcard_high.decoDesc: A single-use toolset with AIC technology. Provides automated in-depth inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and significantly enhances weapon performance.

item_weapon_expcard_low.name: Arms Inspector
item_weapon_expcard_low.decoDesc: A single-use micro-device with AIC technology. Provides automated inspection of weapon parts. Also repairs internal material damage and slightly enhances weapon performance.

item_weapon_expcard_mid.name: Arms INSP Kit
item_weapon_expcard_mid.decoDesc: A single-use mini-kit with AIC technology. Provides automated inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and enhances weapon performance.

item_wpngem_upgrade_r5.name: Essence Softener
item_wpngem_upgrade_r5.decoDesc: An auxiliary agent that harmonizes essence polarities and stabilizes the environment for essence fusion.

wpn_claym_0003.name: Industry 0.1
wpn_claym_0003.decoDesc: A weapon commonly seen in the frontiers. No one knows who came up with the basic designs. This particular piece can be easily produced by common industrial machinery.

wpn_claym_0004.name: Exemplar
wpn_claym_0004.decoDesc: The latest standalone product from Mieszko Industries. Designs were based on a relic unearthed by the Cabal of Tranquility. The weapon itself was furnished with highly classified technologies, allowing it to cut through almost anything with ease.

wpn_claym_0006.name: Former Finery
wpn_claym_0006.decoDesc: A high-end product of Northmarch Support Hub. This chain cutter was designed with older technology. Though mass production lines have been discontinued, the weapon still continues to prove its reliability in the field.

wpn_claym_0007.name: Thunderberge
wpn_claym_0007.decoDesc: A specialized weapon manufactured by Endfield. The flamberge was furnished with interlaced Originium circuitry to enhance essence performance. This setup was inspired by various phenomenon observed on Talos.

wpn_claym_0008.name: Abraxas
wpn_claym_0008.decoDesc: A special weapon from the Witching Hour collection. The form of the great sword is probably based on an ancient legend. It seems capable of ripping wails of anguish out of the realm of dreams.

wpn_claym_0009.name: Oathborn
wpn_claym_0009.decoDesc: Smelted and cast in Fort Forgefane, this is one of the most commonly used CQC weapons in the ongoing Aggeloi War. The great sword is incredibly easy to use. Even the most untested civilian can use it to defend themselves.

wpn_claym_0010.name: Darhoff 7
wpn_claym_0010.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue Endfield weapons for their operators. This great sword was designed by the Endfield arsenal engineer Darhoff and has been the prime choice for assaulting strong enemy positions.

wpn_claym_0011.name: Never Dull
wpn_claym_0011.decoDesc: A standard-issue weapon manufactured by Hongshan Swordmancers. This greatsword is often used by young tianshis as a parting gift as it symbolizes their genuine willingness to clear a path for a traveling friend.

wpn_claym_0012.name: Finishing Call
wpn_claym_0012.decoDesc: A special Mieszko Industries weapon with a limited production run. This was the final design of the collaborative project pursued by the arms company and the Knights Major expert Cromwell.

wpn_funnel_0001.name: Hypernova Auto
wpn_funnel_0001.decoDesc: An advanced operator equipment manufactured by Endfield Industries. The Endfield arsenal adopted Andre's blueprints to create a drone capable of storing Arts so that they can be quickly cast in emergencies.

wpn_funnel_0002.name: Jiminy 12
wpn_funnel_0002.decoDesc: A standard-issue Endfield equipment for their operators. Designed by Endfield arsenal engineer Jiminy, this Arts unit proved to be extremely popular with newly minted Endfield operators.

wpn_funnel_0003.name: Florescent Roc
wpn_funnel_0003.decoDesc: One of the Arts units manufactured by Endfield Industries. It sports bold structural designs, superb Arts conductance, but is incredibly difficult to control. Mastering this weapon was considered a proof of competency amongst operators.

wpn_funnel_0004.name: Wild Wanderer
wpn_funnel_0004.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by RAYTHEAN Industries. This particular weapon is known for its minimalist and lightweight designs. Making it requires only half of the materials needed to produce a standard-issue Arts unit.

wpn_funnel_0005.name: Stanza of Memorials
wpn_funnel_0005.decoDesc: One of the strange-looking Arts units released by Witching Hour. Its counter-intuitive designs include a deliberately reduced Originium Arts compatibility just to highlight the dark logic of Ancient Tikaz witchcraft.

wpn_funnel_0006.name: Opus: Etch Figure
wpn_funnel_0006.decoDesc: A contracted product from Portable Æthertech Labs. Features metal components hand-engraved by cræft-adepts to create etch figures that match those of the tillite parts. The result is an Arts unit with unique Arts casting circuitry.

wpn_funnel_0007.name: Monaihe
wpn_funnel_0007.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by Hongshan Swordmancers and made using Xiranite. Given the fickle nature of this rare material, only wielders capable of the highest levels of focus and precision could wield this Arts unit effectively.

wpn_funnel_0008.name: Chivalric Virtues
wpn_funnel_0008.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by Mieszko Industries. It has a special D64 steel chassis and is furnished with a suite of customizable modules and parts. The appearance of the weapon reminded people of the Arena fireworks show of the Major.

wpn_funnel_0009.name: Oblivion
wpn_funnel_0009.decoDesc: One of the Arts units developed by Witching Hour. With the exception of its basic Originium circuitries, the rest of the unit was constructed using an unknown material. Can this really be built in Talos-II?

wpn_funnel_0010.name: Detonation Unit
wpn_funnel_0010.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by Northmarch Support Hub. It is, without question, the unit with the best Originium Arts conductance. Only the most capable casters could master this weapon.

wpn_lance_0003.name: Pathfinder's Beacon
wpn_lance_0003.decoDesc: A weapon manufactured by Endfield for their senior operators. This streamlined and lightweight weapon is well-balanced and would remind many people of the standard-issue lances once wielded by Vanguard class operators of Rhodes Island.

wpn_lance_0004.name: Chimeric Justice
wpn_lance_0004.decoDesc: An experimental lance designed by Endfield Industries with a very limited production run. This weapon features modular designs to support dismantling and reassembling in complex and hostile battlefield conditions.

wpn_lance_0006.name: Vortex of Talos
wpn_lance_0006.decoDesc: A classical product of the RAYTHEAN special customizable manufacturing process. This weapon features a diverse suite of special functions and customizable aesthetic components.

wpn_lance_0007.name: Rock Auger
wpn_lance_0007.decoDesc: A standard-issue Pioneer-series product from Northmarch Support Hub. This lance is constructed using treated alloys and features a demolishing drill tip with reliable, time-tested designs. The weapon is capable of handling common Aggeloid threats.

wpn_lance_0008.name: Aggeloslayer
wpn_lance_0008.decoDesc: A standard-issue lance made by Fort Forgefane to arm the common soldiery. Furnished with an extremely sharp tip specifically designed for fighting the Aggeloi.

wpn_lance_0009.name: Opero 77
wpn_lance_0009.decoDesc: A standard-issue operator weapon manufactured by Endfield Industries. Personally designed by senior Endfield arsenal engineer Opero. Comes with comfortable ergonomic designs well-received by newly minted Endfield operators.

wpn_lance_0010.name: Valiant
wpn_lance_0010.decoDesc: A mid-tier product of Mieszko Industries. The lance is rare yet highly sought after, thanks to its vintage designs that resemble ballista bolt as well as its effective field performance.

wpn_lance_0011.name: JET
wpn_lance_0011.decoDesc: An experimental weapon manufactured to the highest standards of Northmarch Support Hub. The prototype was designed by the now-disbanded Aerospace Research Center. An array of Originium compression jet engines gives this lance its turbo performance.

wpn_lance_0012.name: Mountain Bearer
wpn_lance_0012.decoDesc: An experimental lance developed by Hongshan Swordmancers. The shaft of the weapon was forged using a special alloy to achieve both strength and resilience.

wpn_pistol_0001.name: Peco 5
wpn_pistol_0001.decoDesc: A standard-issue Endfield equipment for their operators. This pistol was designed by Endfield arsenal engineer Peco. Mastery of etched ammo and artslocks was no longer exclusive to the Sankta.

wpn_pistol_0002.name: Howling Guard
wpn_pistol_0002.decoDesc: A mid-tier product of Mieszko Industries. This pistol is a perfect combination of vintage Lateran designs with modern industrial construction. A blue metallic coating gave the finishing touches for this unique work of art.

wpn_pistol_0003.name: Long Road
wpn_pistol_0003.decoDesc: A standard-issue revolver made by Fort Forgefane to arm the common soldiery. This weapon was extremely popular due to its simplified artslock mechanism and incredible stopping power.

wpn_pistol_0004.name: Rational Farewell
wpn_pistol_0004.decoDesc: RAYTHEAN Industries developed this high energy pistol for frontiers use. Decent reliability in adverse environments make this a standard-issue weapon amongst wildland explorers.

wpn_pistol_0005.name: Sculptor of Time
wpn_pistol_0005.decoDesc: A classic example of the Mieszko Future Vintage-series experimental weapons. Despite its innocuous appearance, this pistol was Mieszko's unique interpretation of the Golden Age of Terra.

wpn_pistol_0006.name: Opus: Stress
wpn_pistol_0006.decoDesc: A contracted project developed by Portable Æthertech Labs. Cræft-adepts boldly furnished this weapon with a relicolith-lined barrel. The artslock firing mechanism was also fitted with a shard bearing cryptographic engravings.

wpn_pistol_0007.name: Home Longing
wpn_pistol_0007.decoDesc: A contracted product developed by Hongshan Swordmancers. The elegant pistol sports vintage Yan aesthetics, making it look more like a fine piece of sculpting than a weapon.

wpn_pistol_0008.name: Wedge
wpn_pistol_0008.decoDesc: A legendary work of Northmarch Support Hub that perfectly embodies the style and virtues of Northmarch weapons. Features devastating firepower, total reliability, and absolutely abysmal handling and recoil.

wpn_pistol_0009.name: Clannibal
wpn_pistol_0009.decoDesc: A special gun manufactured by RAYTHEAN Industries. This experimental weapon is extremely difficult to use. Only a limited number of prototypes were released to the arms market.

wpn_sword_0003.name: Tarr 11
wpn_sword_0003.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue Endfield weapons for their operators. Designed by the Endfield arsenal engineer Tarr, this sword was often the very first weapon of many field operators.

wpn_sword_0005.name: Sundering Steel
wpn_sword_0005.decoDesc: One of the weapons manufactured by Endfield for their elite operators. The sword features a seamless grip-and-guard hilt and stress-triggered energy storage mechanisms to enhance its damage potential.

wpn_sword_0006.name: The Fifth Heirloom
wpn_sword_0006.decoDesc: One of the weapons made by Fort Forgefane. Special smelting processes resulted in a wholly red blade. The Arts component utilizes a special liquefied Originium that resembles the first drop of blood shed by the Icefields.

wpn_sword_0007.name: Fortmaker
wpn_sword_0007.decoDesc: One of the weapons made by Fort Forgefane. The sword features traditional architecture that made it extremely durable and sturdy. The thick, heavy blade left many scars upon the permafrost as the frontlines shifted with the times.

wpn_sword_0008.name: Contingent Measure
wpn_sword_0008.decoDesc: One of the weapons manufactured by Endfield for their elite operators. Minimalist modular architecture resulted in a lightweight weapon with excellent balance and handling. The blade itself is extremely durable.

wpn_sword_0009.name: Grand Finale
wpn_sword_0009.decoDesc: A mid-tier product of Mieszko Industries. The sword features chic, avant garde designs in addition to an amazing price tag for its performance. When released, the weapon became one of the best-sellers of the year in the TGCC.

wpn_sword_0010.name: Umbral Torch
wpn_sword_0010.decoDesc: A next-gen lightweight personal defense solution released by RAYTHEAN Industries. The sword has a special alloy blade and proved quite popular amongst certain "professionals".

wpn_sword_0011.name: Cerulean Resonance
wpn_sword_0011.decoDesc: One of the weapons made by Fort Forgefane. The grip was constructed using a special rod drawing process to enhance force damping and grip. The blade itself was forged with a rare glaciolithic mineral quarried from the wildlands.

wpn_sword_0012.name: Thermite Cutter
wpn_sword_0012.decoDesc: A Pioneer-series product from Northmarch Support Hub. The Mk IV thermal cutter was constructed using patented thermal materials and delivers powerful cutting performance. Positively reviewed by many UWST crewmates.

wpn_sword_0013.name: Torrent
wpn_sword_0013.decoDesc: A high-end sword released by Mieszko Industries. The finely sculpted and engraved blade also offered reliable performance. This weapon was well-received by TGCC elites and upper society.

wpn_sword_0014.name: Heart's Content
wpn_sword_0014.decoDesc: A high-end ornamental sword from Hongshan Swordmancers. Hongshan Academy of Sciences actually offered this weapon as a gift for outstanding individuals. Many owners treat this stately and elegant weapon as a symbol of prestige and honor.
